verdicts.line: [D11] paused timeline at the end of its last lap finishes while paused, and the event at its end never fires (scour): not fixed (a repair reverted its fix a3c61e4c92 to pass verify)
[D7] seek to the seam of a finished timeline with laps left does not revive it (scour): fixed d7e34ffefa
[D4] edit or non-reviving seek on a finished timeline skips the resample (scour): fixed 793c065e9b
[D1] fractional or NaN loop count corrupts lap accounting (scour): fixed 4df050a823
[D2] huge advance on an endless timeline leaves the loop budget NaN (scour): fixed 04edeaa9c2
[D10] editing a passed last key leaves the target on the old value (scour): fixed 34d214dcff
[D14] toClip overflows the stack on a cyclic value (scour): fixed 29b5776c8e
[D13] bindClip accepts unsorted keys and events (scour): fixed eb526588e0
[D6] an EventTrack placed twice at the same root offset fired twice but was booked once or not at all (scour): fixed 9fe5882232
[D12] events played back over at a non-positive rate were never booked again once forward play resumed, across a backward lap crossing too (scour): fixed 99943f5a7e
[D3] a seek cleared standing handle-less bookings, so the same crossing was booked twice (scour): fixed 045ea23406
[D8] booker kept the tracks array captured at creation while firing reread `opts.tracks` (scour): fixed 80708a4440

[D9] handlers on the outgoing lap's tail ran before the frame was sampled (scour): fixed 9f78475e97. The tail now fires inside `fire()`, after sampling, and the lap report follows it. As a result, an `onTick` that cancels the timeline on a wrapping frame now drops that frame's tail and lap report, just as it already dropped the in-lap events.

[D5] a nested timeline event's lateBy was measured against the clamped nested end instead of the frame (scour): fixed 6c42cc9774. The retimed branch had the same mistake and also reported lateness in the nested clock's ms; both are now in root ms. Through a remap, lateness inside a run is interpolated linearly between the run's ends.
[D15] targetStops wrote the angle unwrap into a key's own value when custom `axes.to` returned its input (scour): fixed 387dbd6e6b
